node.title: Schur interpolation-defect formula
node.statement: Normalize each highest clone polynomial to the monic root product H_x(Y)=Y^Delta_x(Y-mu_x) product_(gamma in A_x)(Y-gamma)=sum_j h_j(x)Y^j. After choosing 4m+1 pivot points P, the Schur entry of a nonpivot highest clone is c_(1,x)(x^i h_j(x)-sum_(p in P) ell_p(x)p^i h_j(p)); lower deficiency clones retain their original entries because their top coefficient vanishes. The h_j are exact elementary symmetric functions of the incidence roots, fibre root, and Delta_x zero roots. In the saturated case, full column rank of any one coefficient defect block E_j(P) suffices for full rank of the complete matrix. No such rank bound is asserted here.
